props.name: domain
props.description: The connected domain, or null before one is added.

props.name: records
props.description: Records to add at the DNS provider, with their latest check result.

props.name: sslStatus
props.description: Certificate state. Issued once every record verifies.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Called with a normalised domain. A rejection shows its message.

props.name: onVerify
props.description: Re-check DNS. Update `records` with the results.
